body.statement: When \(L=2\), \(Q_{3,2}\) is a full-dimensional unimodular simplex with seven primitive facets. At \(p_{0,1}=p_{1,1}=p_{2,1}=1/2\), the middle-dose endpoint interval is \([\underline\theta_1(p),\overline\theta_1(p)]=[0,1/4]\), attained respectively by mixtures on \(\{000,111\}\) and \(\{001,010,100,111\}\).
body.justification: The binary reduction checks normalization, dimension, sharpness, and attainment against an exactly invertible base case.
body.gap: This is a required reduction rather than a novelty claim.
body.consumer: It anchors the transfer recurrence and supplies a hand-checkable validation case for software and empirical workflows.
